metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully attached aws-bill.pdf to the 'New-month AWS Bill' compose window in 5 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Thunderbird compose window, attach files, interact with CC address fields, save drafts.
metadata.explanation: Most complex variation: chains CC addition, attachment, and saving as draft. Getter searches Thunderbird Drafts MBOX for the aws-bill.pdf filename, then checks the same draft file for a Cc: header containing cfo@outlook.com. Initial state has no draft, so evaluator will not pass spuriously. Partial credit: 0.5 per sub-goal. [Fixed: added check_ prefix to evaluator.func to match actual metric function name]
fix_history: Fix 1: Updated evaluator.func from 'thunderbird_draft_cc_attachment__ae64d5efe053bb1ed61ef261c2f7eddd' to 'check_thunderbird_draft_cc_attachment__ae64d5efe053bb1ed61ef261c2f7eddd' to match actual function name in metrics file

scoring_breakdown.draft_with_attachment: 0.5 - Thunderbird Drafts MBOX contains aws-bill.pdf attachment reference
scoring_breakdown.draft_with_cc: 0.5 - Saved draft Cc: header contains cfo@outlook.com

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly searches the Thunderbird Drafts MBOX for a draft containing 'aws-bill.pdf' in MIME headers, reliably detecting the attachment requirement.
Getter correctly checks the Cc: header of the located draft for 'cfo@outlook.com', verifying the CC requirement.
The 'save as draft' requirement is implicitly and correctly verified by finding content in the Drafts MBOX rather than just the compose window.
All 3 instruction requirements (add CC, attach file, save as draft) are covered by the evaluator.
Partial credit scoring (0.5 per sub-goal) is semantically appropriate for this multi-step task.
Metric function correctly uses result boolean flags without incorrectly accessing expected parameter; expected.type='rule' does not cause issues here.
Negative control resistance is good: initial state has no draft, so evaluator will not pass spuriously.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: draft_with_cc is only checked if a draft containing 'aws-bill.pdf' is found first. If a user saves the draft with CC but without the attachment, they receive 0 credit for CC. Consider making the CC check independent (search all Drafts files for the Cc: header) to allow partial credit even when attachment is missing.
